title: Auxeria And Astrum
description: Dual-tower development integrating commercial retail on lower levels with luxury residences above.

specifications.structuralSystem: Integrated composite structural grid featuring transfer slab/girder system at podium transition level (Level 4) transferring residential column loads into commercial grid below, fully compliant with IS 456 & IS 1893.
unitMix: Ground & 1st Floor Boulevard Retail & Dining (750 – 2,400 sq.ft.)
4th to 16th Floor 3 & 4 BHK Residential Apartments (1,550 – 2,800 sq.ft.)
vastuHighlights: Segregated residential and commercial entry gates aligned to auspicious directional axes
Commercial storefronts facing high-vibrancy North/East street frontages
Residential tower entrance oriented with quiet North-East landscaped gateway
Kitchen and utility stacks aligned in Agni (South-East) and Vayu (North-West) quadrants
amenitiesList: Complete physical segregation between commercial visitors and residential residents
Podium-level landscaped community deck on 4th floor with swimming pool and gym
Dedicated retail boulevard promenade with visitor surface parking
Advanced dual-level basement car parking with access-controlled residential ramps
Solar-powered common area illumination & organic waste composting unit

floorPlans.title: Ground & Podium Mixed-Use Integration Plan
floorPlans.description: Street-facing retail arcades with separate vehicular arrival loops for residents and shoppers, dedicated service corridors, and security checkpoints.

floorPlans.title: Podium Amenity Deck (4th Floor)
floorPlans.description: Elevated residents-only podium featuring clubhouse, lap pool, kids splash pool, yoga pavilion, and landscaped gardens isolated from street noise.

floorPlans.title: Typical Residential Tower Floor Plan
floorPlans.description: Four corner-facing residential residences per floor ensuring three-sided open ventilation, private foyer entries, and service elevator access.

floorPlans.title: 3 BHK Family Residence Plan
floorPlans.description: Spacious living room, dining bay, modular kitchen with store room & utility, three attached bathrooms, and expansive scenic balcony.
